parameters.name: BgImageConfig
parameters.description:
The configuration of the background resource. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **BgImageConfig**.

><notice>

This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to studio.

></notice>

parameters.name: CasterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the production studio. ><notice>The production studio must be created in advance and must be of the virtual studio type.></notice>

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **ApsaraVideo Live console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

parameters.name: CommonConfig
parameters.description: The configuration of the common layout. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **CommonConfig**. ><notice>This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to common.></notice>

parameters.name: LayerOrderConfigList
parameters.description: The layer order settings. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **layerOrderConfig**. You can sort background and multimedia materials. Chroma keying layers are not supported. The earlier an item appears in the list, the lower its layer.

parameters.name: LayoutId
parameters.description: The ID of the layout. If you add a layout for a production studio by calling the [AddStudioLayout](~~2848062~~) operation, use the LayoutId value returned in the response.

parameters.name: LayoutName
parameters.description: The name of the production studio layout.

parameters.name: MediaInputConfigList
parameters.description:
The settings for the multimedia input resource. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **MediaInputConfig**.

><notice>

This parameter is valid and optional only when LayoutType is set to studio.

></notice>

parameters.name: ScreenInputConfigList
parameters.description:
The settings for the chroma keying input. This parameter is a JSON string. For more information, see **ScreenInputConfig**.

><notice>

This parameter is required only when LayoutType is set to studio.

></notice>
